summary: A three-story residential building with a gable roof featuring dark wood shingles. The structure uses stone brick for walls with regular window patterns on each floor. A small chimney or tower element protrudes from the right side. The building sits on a dirt foundation with a rectangular footprint.

gable roof with dark wood shingles
